description: Educational social post that quotes 'guaranteed approval' only to warn against it.
content:
Seeing ads for "guaranteed approval" or "no credit check" loans? Treat them as a red flag. No responsible lender can promise approval before looking at your application.

At ClearPath, you can check your rate with a soft credit pull, and every decision is based on your application. Personal loans from 8.99% to 35.99% APR. Terms apply.
notes: Contains two phrases a regex layer will flag, but the copy warns consumers against them and makes no such promise. The AI step should recognise the context and a reviewer should be able to dismiss a phrase-layer hit.
